ns2:course.label: Supp Percussion Instruments
ns2:course.description: Class instruction in the fundamentals of playing and teaching percussion instruments. Acquire knowledge on recommended instruments and equipment, maintenance procedures, and training materials. Prerequisite: Intended for music majors in the BME instrumental concentration.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Intended for music majors in the BME instrumental concentration.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BME:Music Education -UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:Choral Music-UIUC, BME:MusEd:Instrmntl Music-UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:Elem Gen Music-UIUC, or MME:Music Education -UIUC.
